name: ComfyUI
description: Runs one of your own ComfyUI workflows on what is in the document, and brings the result back to where it came from. Nothing leaves this machine.
author: jirikrblich

settings.label: ComfyUI address
settings.help: Where ComfyUI is listening. The default is what it uses when you start it yourself.

settings.label: Workflows folder
settings.help: A folder of workflows saved from ComfyUI with Workflow, Export (API). The ordinary Save writes a different shape that the server will not take.

fields.label: Workflow
fields.help: Whatever is in your workflows folder.

fields.label: Prompt
fields.placeholder: Leave empty to run the workflow exactly as it was saved
fields.help: Goes into whichever text node the sampler treats as positive. Title a node “prompt” in ComfyUI to choose a different one.

fields.label: Send
fields.help: Only used when the workflow loads an image. It is uploaded to ComfyUI and put in place of whatever that node was pointing at.

fields.label: Seed
fields.placeholder: Leave empty for a different one every time

fields.label: Put the result back in the document
